correctness.rationale: Every phase arc can be unwrapped into an increasing equal-width interval chain with total span strictly below P. At least r overlapping intervals have a consecutive-r subblock; union of all these intersections yields the exact closed form. Both one-sided derivatives are strictly positive below detuning w/r and strictly negative above until coverage vanishes, so unique global optimizer P=1-w/r. Exact-rational independently computed 29,988 finite assertions. Universal result follows from full proof, not brute force.

value.rationale: The sharp two-lobe daily alias phenomenon and exact r-visit phase-coverage benchmark quantify the effect of very small orbital-period detuning. The model is well-motivated by published observing-window methods and explicitly exposes an exact strict local coverage minimum at daily resonance, both peak positions and their unequal heights, plus fixed-observing-budget large-N discontinuity. For a 30-night ten-minute campaign it predicts roughly 14.55x center-hit coverage gain, valuable as a transparent limiting-case diagnostic for more realistic surveys, without misrepresenting this as actual survey success probability.
